description: React component for displaying a remote image with upload and save functionality, integrated with Lexical editor and application context.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining properties for RemoteImageComponent, including src, alt, node, className, format, nodeKey.

methods.name: RemoteImageComponent

methods.name: fetchAndUploadImage
